Q1.question: How many hospitals in Harris County, Texas are inside FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area (the 1%-annual-chance floodplain)?
Q1.tests: one point layer with a county field, one polygon layer, a point-in-polygon count

Q2.question: Name the nursing homes in Orleans Parish, Louisiana that are inside FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area.
Q2.tests: the same overlay, answered as a list of names

Q3.question: How many public schools in Miami-Dade County, Florida are inside FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area?
Q3.tests: a large layer (102,000 schools) that has to be filtered to one county before the overlay; Florida has AH zones as well as AE

Q4.question: How many nursing homes in Charleston County, South Carolina are in the 0.2%-annual-chance flood hazard area (the shaded X zone), not counting any in the Special Flood Hazard Area?
Q4.tests: the right flood zone attribute: shaded X is a zone subtype, not a zone of its own

Q5.question: How many fire and EMS stations in Miami-Dade County, Florida are inside FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area?
Q5.tests: a layer with no county field, stored in Web Mercator, so the county filter has to be spatial

Q6.question: Which operating power plants in Harris County, Texas with an operating capacity of at least 100 MW are within 500 meters of FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area (including any inside it)? Give their names.
Q6.tests: a distance in meters on layers stored in Web Mercator and geographic coordinates; a status filter; a capacity field with -999999 for missing

Q7.question: How many kilometers of electric transmission line rated 345 kV or more run through FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area in Harris County, Texas?
Q7.tests: lines clipped to a county and to the floodplain, a length in a projected CRS, a voltage field with -999999 for missing

Q8.question: What is the total number of licensed beds in the open hospitals inside FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area in Miami-Dade County, Florida?
Q8.tests: an overlay followed by a sum of an attribute, with a status filter

Q9.question: How many electric substations in Orleans Parish, Louisiana are inside FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area?
Q9.tests: HIFLD Next has no electric substations layer (DHS withdrew it from public HIFLD in 2022). The right answer says the data isn't there; any count is invented.
Q9.why: HIFLD Next has no electric substations layer

Q10.question: What percentage of the dialysis centers in Harris County, Texas are inside FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area?
Q10.tests: a layer with no county field, stored in Web Mercator, and a ratio whose denominator also needs the spatial county filter
